name: Other open-source ABM tools
description: Collection of additional open-source agent-based modeling platforms and frameworks (e.g., MASON, Swarm, GAMA) beyond NetLogo and Repast Simphony, each offering distinct strengths in performance, domain focus, or ease of use.
reputation: Diverse and active ecosystem supporting specialized research needs in social simulation, ecology, and geospatial modeling.
notes: Tool choice depends on specific requirements (e.g., scalability vs. visualization); community support and documentation quality vary.
